evidence: beafertility.com is Béa Fertility's own site (Trustpilot/terms pages), and 7percent Ventures' portfolio page confirms the investor match.
Protex AI's official site is protex.ai; Playfair Capital's own portfolio page confirms it backs Protex AI since 2021.
Official Enzai AI governance platform site is enz.ai; Seedcamp's own site confirms the investment (name matches ignoring punctuation).

elevaate.com is Elevaate's site ('Elevaate - Grow Revenue with Scalable Partner Programs'); Haatch's own blog confirms its founder Scott Weavers-Wright also founded Haatch. Company was acquired by Quotient Technology in 2018 but the domain still resolves to the Elevaate brand.
EyeEm is a well-known Berlin photo app; eyeem.com is its long-standing official domain, and multiple funding articles confirm Passion Capital as an early/recurring backer.
boomfi.xyz is BoomFi's crypto payment gateway site; PR Newswire and LinkedIn confirm Passion Capital backed BoomFi's $3.8M seed.
tellis.ai matches the e-commerce AI platform description and Haatch backing (also referred to as 'Tellis Labs'), a partial name match.
roundtreasury.com is Round Treasury's own site; press coverage confirms the pre-seed round was led by Passion Capital with Ascension participating, matching both investor names.

inversionsemi.com is the only Inversion Semiconductor found (YC-backed lithography startup); however visible investor lists show Y Combinator/Entrepreneur First rather than Moonfire, so the investor hint is unconfirmed.
solvo.finance is Solvo's official crypto investing app site; Index Ventures' own site confirms it led Solvo's seed round.
liquidtrust.io is LiquidTrust's own escrow-payments site; Anthemis's own portfolio page confirms the investment.
getinflow.io is Inflow's official ADHD-app site; Hoxton Ventures' own portfolio page and TechCrunch confirm it led Inflow's seed round.

Property Partner rebranded to London House Exchange (per Trustpilot/APIs.io); Seedcamp backed the original £1.25m seed round. Domain reflects the renamed current entity, not the old propertypartner.co branding.
grubel.ai is the AI legal research lab's own site ('grubel — every matter, its own AI'); EU-Startups and Point Nine's own site confirm the pre-seed round Point Nine led.
vigilant-ai.ai is Vigilant AI's own press-release/blog domain; multiple outlets confirm Haatch led its £585k pre-seed round.

rezilion.com was Rezilion's official domain (per TechCrunch and a certificate-history record) and TechCrunch/SiliconAngle confirm Kindred Capital's participation in its Series A, but the domain currently resolves to an unrelated site, suggesting it may have lapsed.
wayline.com is Wayline's own AI property-management site; VCBacked/PitchBook list Moonfire among its pre-seed investors.

candidhospitality.co.uk is Candid Hospitality's own site; Haatch's portfolio page and press confirm its participation in the seed round. Batch entry name 'Candid' is a partial match to the full 'Candid Hospitality' brand.

Moltin, backed by Frontline Ventures per Medium/Tech.eu coverage, was acquired by Elastic Path in January 2020; elasticpath.com is the current official domain for the combined company (moltin.com content now lives under Elastic Path's site).
vicampo.de is Vicampo's own wine-retail site, still active; Gruenderszene/FinSMES confirm Passion Capital's investment, though ViCampo was later acquired by Viva Wine & Spirits in 2021.
heatio.com is Heatio's own home-energy-platform site; Ascension's own blog confirms it led the Liverpool clean-tech startup's £2m seed round.
fenka.de is FENKA Robotics' own site; Playfair Capital's careers page and startup-map.berlin list Playfair as an investor. Batch entry name 'Fenka' is a partial match to 'FENKA Robotics'.

Multiple unrelated companies are named 'Ambient' (a US Ambient.ai, Ambient Property Technologies, a blockchain project, etc.); PitchBook lists a vague 'Ambient (Software Development Applications)' exit tied to Connect Ventures but no site could be confirmed, so the investor hint does not disambiguate.
bookend.ai is confirmed as Bookend AI's site via Dealroom/VCSheet, and Seedcamp's own site lists Bookend among its 2023 investments.
yourpersi.com is Persi's own fashion-tech site; Haatch's portfolio page and multiple articles confirm it led Persi's £660k pre-seed round.
themoonhub.com is confirmed as MOONHUB's official site directly on Ada Ventures' own portfolio page, which lists it as an investor.

sentimoto.com is confirmed via Crunchbase/Dealroom/RocketReach as Sentimoto's site, and Anthemis's own portfolio page lists Sentimoto; however this is an old (2013-2017) UK wearable-wellbeing startup and may no longer be operating.
peppy.health is Peppy's own employee-healthcare site; Seedcamp's own site confirms its 2019 investment in Peppy.
Guardian Angel rebranded to Octopus Legacy per octopuslegacy.com itself ('formerly known as Guardian Angel'); Ascension/Fair By Design sources confirm Ascension backed and exited Guardian Angel.
kammadata.com is Kamma's own property-licensing site; RAM Capital's Ascension EIS fund document lists Kamma as a portfolio company.
joinbubble.com is Bubble Childcare's own site ('Bubble - Find top-rated sitters'); Ada Ventures' own portfolio page confirms it led Bubble's £2m round.
Vidya Health (saliva-testing diagnostics, Hoxton Ventures board seat) appears in Hoxton's portfolio as 'ADMINISTRATION' (i.e. defunct), and no working official domain could be found.

aigizmo.io ('close the drift between Design, Documents and Site', an agentic construction-workflow platform) closely matches Haatch's portfolio description of Ai Gizmo as a workflow-automation platform for urban planning/energy/construction; not fully certain given a similarly named unrelated 'theaigizmo.com' real-estate marketing tool also exists.

readmill.com is confirmed as Readmill's official domain via WSJ coverage; TechCrunch/FinSMEs confirm Passion Capital and Index Ventures backed it, but the company shut down in 2014 after being acqui-hired by Dropbox.
looop.co is still live as 'Looop by 360Learning'; RAM Capital's Ascension EIS document confirms Looop was an Ascension portfolio company, later acquired by 360Learning in 2022.
kisanhub.com is confirmed via pseps.com/VC data as KisanHub's official site; Notion Capital's own newsletter names KisanHub as a portfolio company.
The company's name is its domain, fulfilment.com; multiple press articles and Haatch's own portfolio page confirm Haatch backed its seed round.

thread.com is confirmed via Bdaily/TechCrunch as the London menswear-styling startup's official domain, and Passion Capital-linked sources (Caplink) describe the same AI+stylist business; the company wound down in 2022 with assets sold to a UK clothing retailer.
pharosyn.ai is Pharosyn's own site ('Optimizing Pharma Decision-Making'); numerous September 2026 articles confirm Moonfire led its seed round.
nueworx.com is Nueworx's own AI service-desk platform site; Haatch's own portfolio page and LinkedIn posts confirm Haatch backed Nueworx.
hypergtm.com is hyperGTM's own site; Haatch's own portfolio page lists hyperGTM as a 2024 pre-seed SEIS investment.
icite.io is Icite's own identity-security site; Crane Venture Partners' own site (crane.vc) and LinkedIn confirm Crane backed Icite.

PitchBook references an Ada Ventures-backed, exited 'Insitu (Business/Productivity Software)' company, but no distinguishing details or working domain could be found, and the name is heavily confused with the unrelated aerospace company Insitu Inc.

Two different 'Unison' startups surfaced (a Passion Capital/Francis Crick-backed biotech data-harmonisation company referred to as 'Unison (Federation)', and an unrelated 'hyperunison.com' AI-data startup); neither had a confirmable, unambiguous official domain matching the investor hint.
gosquared.com is GoSquared's own site; its own blog/timeline confirms Passion Capital as an investor.
iamfy.co is Fy!'s own wall-art marketplace site; TechCrunch and Hoxton Ventures' own fund announcements confirm Hoxton backed the homewares marketplace Fy!.

xihelm.com is referenced as Xihelm's domain across LinkedIn/Crunchbase/Companies House records, and Wellfound confirms Passion Capital invested; however Xihelm is now deadpooled (per Tracxn) and the domain currently shows only a generic 'coming soon' placeholder.
lafraise.pro is La Fraise Pro's own dental-SaaS site, and Seedcamp's own 'Our Companies' page links directly to it as a 2025 investment.
roomex.com is Roomex's own site, which itself states the company's £3.5m round was led by Frontline Ventures.
Zaro is widely referred to as 'Zaro.ai' (per LinkedIn/Sifted/Tech.eu coverage) and Cherry Ventures' own portfolio page confirms it led Zaro's $5.1m pre-seed round.
